name: chatgpt-headless
description: Ask GPT models from your ChatGPT account headlessly (second opinions, brainstorming, independent review) via the official Codex backend, reusing the OAuth tokens from ~/.codex/auth.json. No UI, no screen interruption. Friendly model aliases (fast/balanced/smart/mini), /gpt and /debate commands, and a silent GPT auto-review hook for big edits.
